_about: The single source of truth for the MSME working-capital office: departments, the one agent per department, and the lightweight desk roles (not separate agents). src/data.js (3D office), msme/roster.mjs and the engine all read this file. 'slot' only places the pod on the floor.
title: MSME Working-Capital Arbiter

agent.name: SALES AGENT
agent.does: Proposes order acceptance, credit terms and stock-clearing discounts that grow revenue, and says what each one costs in cash.

desks.name: ORDER INTAKE
desks.does: Watches incoming orders and turns them into bulk-order proposals.

desks.name: CREDIT TERMS
desks.does: Sizes how much extra credit a customer can be given.

desks.name: DISCOUNTING
desks.does: Finds slow stock that is worth clearing at a discount.

agent.name: PROCUREMENT AGENT
agent.does: Proposes reorders and supplier prepayments so the shelves never run dry, and flags the cash and warehouse space they need.

desks.name: REORDER PLANNER
desks.does: Works out how much to reorder from demand and lead time.

desks.name: SUPPLIER TERMS
desks.does: Tracks supplier credit terms and early-payment discounts.

desks.name: STOCK MONITOR
desks.does: Watches stock cover against the warehouse limit.

agent.name: PRODUCTION AGENT
agent.does: Proposes overtime and maintenance spend to keep output up, and states the cash they take from the week.

desks.name: CAPACITY PLANNER
desks.does: Compares demand to what the line can make.

desks.name: PAYROLL
desks.does: Keeps the weekly wage run and overtime cost in view.

desks.name: MAINTENANCE
desks.does: Tracks machine hours since the last service.

agent.name: COLLECTIONS AGENT
agent.does: Proposes dunning, early-payment discounts and invoice factoring to pull cash in sooner, and prices each one.

desks.name: INVOICE AGEING
desks.does: Buckets receivables by days outstanding.

desks.name: DUNNING
desks.does: Chooses which overdue customers to chase first.

desks.name: FACTORING EVALUATOR
desks.does: Prices invoice factoring against the fee.

agent.name: TREASURY AGENT
agent.does: Proposes overdraft draws and repayments, payables timing and early payments to keep cash on the right side of zero.

desks.name: CASH FORECASTER
desks.does: Projects cash for the next four weeks.

desks.name: PAYABLES SCHEDULER
desks.does: Orders supplier payments by due date.

desks.name: LOAN / OVERDRAFT
desks.does: Tracks the overdraft limit and its interest.

agent.name: COMPLIANCE AGENT
agent.does: Proposes the payments the law and the bank covenant require: overdue MSME suppliers and GST dues.

desks.name: PAYMENT-TERM RULES
desks.does: Watches the 45-day MSME payment rule on every supplier invoice.

desks.name: COVENANT CHECK
desks.does: Watches the bank's current-ratio covenant.

desks.name: TAX DATES (GST)
desks.does: Tracks the GST return and payment dates.

agent.name: ARBITER
agent.does: Takes every department's proposals for the week, drops or trims the ones that break a hard financial constraint, and keeps the best feasible set. Plain code decides, and writes the reason for each decision.

desks.name: CONFLICT DETECTOR
desks.does: Finds proposals that fight over the same cash or contradict each other.

desks.name: CONSTRAINT CHECKER
desks.does: Runs the hard constraints: cash buffer, overdraft limit, covenant, 45-day rule, warehouse space.

desks.name: EXPLAINER
desks.does: Writes the plain-language reason for each decision.
